evidence: Matches the Wallet label and modifies descriptor key expansion in src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp.
rationale: Fixes an ownership inconsistency across restarts where keys below range_start are falsely marked IsMine until reload, while eliminating potential hangs from deriving up to 2^31 keys on high range offsets. The author demonstrated that importing range [600000, 600009] dropped from 19.5s to 0.09s, preventing both substantial performance degradation and redundant re-expansions on wallet load.
